interface.longDescription:
Name Ideas Generator helps you find a great name for your business, company, startup, brand, product, app or website, and a domain to go with it.

How it works: it asks a few quick questions, one at a time, about what you are naming, who it is for, the feeling you want and the naming style you like. Then it suggests names in three groups, from clear and descriptive to bold and inventive, explains each one, and gives each name a domain idea.

What you can do:
- Business and company names: names that fit your customers, your market and your personality.
- Startup, brand, product and app names: brandable blends, invented words and names with a story behind them.
- Domain names: domain ideas for any ending, with smart variations and other endings to choose from.
- Name ratings: see how easy each name is to say, spell and type, with its length, syllables and possible spelling problems.
- Name reviews: compare names you already have for clarity, memorability, spelling and fit, and get stronger alternatives.

How the name rating works: a tool on our server measures each name's length, estimated syllables and domain form, flags possible problems such as numbers, sound-alike spellings and doubled letters where words meet, and gives an ease score out of 100. It works only on the names it receives and stores nothing.

Who it is for: founders, small business owners, freelancers, marketers, creators and anyone naming something new.

Limitations: Name Ideas Generator does not check whether domains are available, register domains or check trademarks. Check your favorite domains at a domain registrar and the trademark databases of your countries before you decide on a name. Name Ideas Generator is an independent plugin by AI Research Plus.
capabilities: Startup, brand, product and app names
Domain name ideas for any extension
Rate names for spelling and domain fit
Review and compare your own name ideas
defaultPrompt: Find a name for my business

positive.prompt: Rate these names for my bakery: Crumbly, Kwik Loaf, Oven & Oak.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the name rating with the three names, reports their ease scores and the flags that matter (the "kw" spelling in Kwik Loaf, "&" becoming "and" in the domain idea), recommends one, and does not say whether any domain is available.

positive.prompt: Which is easier to spell and say: Tidewell or Harborly? They're names for my day spa.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the name rating with both names, compares their letters, syllables and ease scores, recommends one for a day spa, and does not say whether any domain is available.

positive.description: Name with a number in it
positive.prompt: Is Studio 54 Bakery a good name for my bakery website?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the name rating with the name, points out that the number makes the domain idea harder to type, suggests better alternatives after rating them, and tells the user to check domain availability at a domain registrar.

positive.prompt: Compare Zyntrix, Novaro and Bloomly as names for my skincare startup.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the name rating with the three names, scores each for clarity, memorability, spelling and fit with skincare, recommends one, and offers rated alternatives, without saying whether any domain is available.

positive.prompt: Help me find a name for my new coffee shop.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the services check once, then asks a single question about the coffee shop and ends it with a progress marker such as [Question 1/5], without suggesting names yet.

negative.prompt: How many ounces are in a pound?
Write a short thank-you note to my landlord.
Summarize the plot of Hamlet in three sentences.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Clearer naming flow: one question at a time with a progress marker, names from straightforward to creative, and next steps after the names for checking your favorite domains and forming your business.
